name: entity
comment: (Elucidation) An entity is anything that exists or has existed or will exist

name: continuant
comment: (Elucidation) A continuant is an entity that persists, endures, or continues to exist through time while maintaining its identity

name: occurrent
comment: (Elucidation) An occurrent is an entity that unfolds itself in time or it is the start or end of such an entity or it is a temporal or spatiotemporal region

name: independent continuant
comment: b is an independent continuant =Def b is a continuant & there is no c such that b specifically depends on c or b generically depends on c

name: spatial region
comment: (Elucidation) A spatial region is a continuant entity that is a continuant part of the spatial projection of a portion of spacetime at a given time

name: temporal region
comment: (Elucidation) A temporal region is an occurrent over which processes can unfold

name: two-dimensional spatial region
comment: (Elucidation) A two-dimensional spatial region is a spatial region that is a whole consisting of a surface together with zero or more surfaces which may have spatial regions of lower dimension as parts

name: spatiotemporal region
comment: (Elucidation) A spatiotemporal region is an occurrent that is an occurrent part of spacetime

name: process
comment: (Elucidation) p is a process means p is an occurrent that has some temporal proper part and for some time t, p has some material entity as participant

name: disposition
comment: (Elucidation) A disposition b is a realizable entity such that if b ceases to exist then its bearer is physically changed & b's realization occurs when and because this bearer is in some special physical circumstances & this realization occurs in virtue of the bearer's physical make-up

name: realizable entity
comment: (Elucidation) A realizable entity is a specifically dependent continuant that inheres in some independent continuant which is not a spatial region & which is of a type some instances of which are realized in processes of a correlated type

name: zero-dimensional spatial region
comment: (Elucidation) A zero-dimensional spatial region is one or a collection of more than one spatially disjoint points in space

name: quality
comment: (Elucidation) A quality is a specifically dependent continuant that, in contrast to roles and dispositions, does not require any further process in order to be realized

name: specifically dependent continuant
comment: b is a specifically dependent continuant =Def b is a continuant & there is some independent continuant c which is not a spatial region & which is such that b specifically depends on c

name: role
comment: (Elucidation) A role b is a realizable entity such that b exists because there is some single bearer that is in some special physical, social, or institutional set of circumstances in which this bearer does not have to be & b is not such that, if it ceases to exist, then the physical make-up of the bearer is thereby changed

name: fiat object part
comment: (Elucidation) A fiat object part b is a material entity & such that if b exists then it is continuant part of some object c & demarcated from the remainder of c by one or more fiat surfaces

name: one-dimensional spatial region
comment: (Elucidation) A one-dimensional spatial region is a whole consisting of a line together with zero or more lines which may have points as parts

name: object aggregate
comment: (Elucidation) An object aggregate is a material entity consisting exactly of a plurality (≥1) of objects as member parts which together form a unit

name: three-dimensional spatial region
comment: (Elucidation) A three-dimensional spatial region is a whole consisting of a spatial volume together with zero or more spatial volumes which may have spatial regions of lower dimension as parts

name: site
comment: (Elucidation) A site is a three-dimensional immaterial entity whose boundaries either (partially or wholly) coincide with the boundaries of one or more material entities or have locations determined in relation to some material entity

name: object
comment: (Elucidation) An object is a material entity which manifests causal unity & is of a type instances of which are maximal relative to the sort of causal unity manifested

name: generically dependent continuant
comment: (Elucidation) A generically dependent continuant is an entity that exists in virtue of the fact that there is at least one of what may be multiple copies which is the content or the pattern that multiple copies would share

name: function
comment: (Elucidation) A function is a disposition that exists in virtue of its bearer's physical make-up & this physical make-up is something the bearer possesses because it came into being either through evolution (in the case of natural biological entities) or through intentional design (in the case of artefacts) in order to realize processes of a certain sort

name: process boundary
comment: p is a process boundary =Def p is a temporal part of a process & p has no proper temporal parts

name: one-dimensional temporal region
comment: (Elucidation) A one-dimensional temporal region is a temporal region that is a whole that has a temporal interval and zero or more temporal intervals and temporal instants as parts

name: material entity
comment: (Elucidation) A material entity is an independent continuant that at all times at which it exists has some portion of matter as continuant part

name: continuant fiat boundary
comment: (Elucidation) A continuant fiat boundary b is an immaterial entity that is of zero, one or two dimensions & such that there is no time t when b has a spatial region as continuant part & whose location is determined in relation to some material entity

name: immaterial entity
comment: b is an immaterial entity =Def b is an independent continuant which is such that there is no time t when it has a material entity as continuant part

name: fiat line
comment: (Elucidation) A fiat line is a one-dimensional continuant fiat boundary that is continuous

name: relational quality
comment: b is a relational quality =Def b is a quality & there exists c and d such that c and d are not identical & b specifically depends on c & b specifically depends on d

name: fiat surface
comment: (Elucidation) A fiat surface is a two-dimensional continuant fiat boundary that is self-connected

name: fiat point
comment: (Elucidation) A fiat point is a zero-dimensional continuant fiat boundary that consists of a single point

name: zero-dimensional temporal region
comment: (Elucidation) A zero-dimensional temporal region is a temporal region that is a whole consisting of one or more separated temporal instants as parts

name: history
comment: (Elucidation) A history is a process that is the sum of the totality of processes taking place in the spatiotemporal region occupied by the material part of a material entity

name: temporal interval
comment: (Elucidation) A temporal interval is a one-dimensional temporal region that is continuous, thus without gaps or breaks

name: temporal instant
comment: (Elucidation) A temporal instant is a zero-dimensional temporal region that has no proper temporal part

name: Gasoline Engine
comment: Label choice here is somewhat pragmatic and doesn't reflect the actual differentiating criteria. Some may refer to engines of this type as 'Otto cycle', but that is only partially correct, since many spark ignition engines use a two stroke cycle and Otto cycle engines are four stroke spark ignition engines.

name: Infantry Fighting Vehicle
comment: Comment: Infantry Fighting Vehicles (IFVs) are differentiated from Armored Personnel Carriers (APCs) because they are designed to give direct fire support to the dismounted infantry and so usually have significantly enhanced armament. IFVs also often have improved armour and firing ports (allowing the infantry to fire personal weapons while mounted).

name: Jet Engine
comment: Needs to be aligned with Space Object Ontology. Some jet engines (most) utilize turbines, but some do not. Most rocket engines do not, but some do.

name: Payload
comment:
Depending on the nature of the Flight or Mission, the Payload of a Vehicle may include cargo, passengers, flight crew, munitions, scientific instruments or experiments, or other equipment. Extra fuel, when optionally carried, is also considered part of the payload.
(Adapted from: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Payload)

comment:
Consider adding the following axioms:

'bearer of' some 'Radio Communication Reception Artifact Function'
'bearer of' some 'Radio Wave Conversion Artifact Function'

name: Act of Artifact Modification
comment: Comment: Excluded from this class would be instaces of role change or creation such as introduction of an artifact as a piece of evidence in a trial or loading of artifacts onto a ship for transport.

name: Act of Commissive Communication
comment: Examples: agreeing, betting, guaranteeing, inviting, offering, promising, swearing, volunteering

name: Act of Conducting Mass Media Interview
Act of Declarative Communication
comment: Examples: Baptism, Sentencing a person to imprisonment, Pronouncing a couple husband and wife, Declaring war

name: Act of Directive Communication
comment: Examples: advising, admonishing, asking, begging, dismissing, excusing, forbidding, instructing, ordering, permitting, requesting, requiring, suggesting, urging, warning

name: Act of Expressive Communication
comment: Examples: apologizing, condoling, congratulating, greeting, thanking, accepting (acknowledging an acknowledgment)

name: Act of Issuing Mass Media Article
Act of Issuing Mass Media Documentary
Act of Issuing Mass Media Press Release
Act of Ownership
comment: The relation between the owner and property may be private, collective, or common and the property may be objects, land, real estate, or intellectual property.

name: Act of Portion of Material Consumption
Act of Position Change
comment: An Act of Position Change does not entail a change of location.

name: Act of Possession
comment: In all cases, to possess something, an agent must have an intention to possess it.

name: Act of Publishing Mass Media Article
Act of Publishing Mass Media Documentary
Act of Publishing Mass Media Press Release
Act of Remuneration
comment: Comment: Remuneration normally consists of salary or hourly wages, but also applies to commission, stock options, fringe benefits, etc.

name: Act of Representative Communication
comment: Examples: affirming, alleging, announcing, answering, attributing, claiming, classifying, concurring, confirming, conjecturing, denying, disagreeing, disclosing, disputing, identifying, informing, insisting, predicting, ranking, reporting, stating, stipulating

name: Decrease of Generically Dependent Continuant
comment: Comment: For the most part Generically Dependent Continuants do not inhere in their bearers over some continuous scale. The primary exception is religion and this class allows annotation of those cases where an Agent is described as becoming less religious. Other cases would include the decrease of an organization's bearing of some objective.

name: Decrease of Quality
comment: Examples: Weight Loss, Decreasing Temperature, decreasing color intensity, loss of structural integrity

name: Essential Service Provision
comment: An essential service is defined here as being one of: medical care, food and water, shelter, or sanitation.

name: Gain of Disposition
comment: This class should be used to demarcate the start of the temporal interval (through the occurs_on property) that the Entity bears the Disposition.

name: Gain of Function
comment: This class should be used to demarcate the start of the temporal interval (through the occurs_on property) that the Entity bears the Function.

name: Gain of Generically Dependent Continuant
comment: Examples: A Person forms a Plan, A Person is initiated into a Religion, A photgraphic image is produced.

name: Gain of Quality
comment: Examples: A person becoming pregnant.

name: Gain of Realizable Entity
comment: Examples: An informant becomes unreliable (disposition), A person begins to speak French (function), a person becomes a welder (role).

name: Gain of Role
comment: This class should be used to demarcate the start of the temporal interval (through the occurs_on property) that the Entity bears the Role.

name: Gain of Specifically Dependent Continuant
comment: Examples: A Person becomes pregnant (gain of quality), A person becomes forgetful (gain of disposition), A vehicle becomes amphibious (gain of function), A Person becomes a Database Administrator (gain of role).

name: Webcast
comment: Essentially, webcasting is “broadcasting” over the Internet.
